Your questions, answered.

What services does FBS offer?

FBS offers free home consultations, measuring and advice, and professional fitting in collaboration with fitting specialists. Discuss your new-home, renovation, residential or commercial project with the team.

Is the home consultation free?

Yes. FBS’s home consultation is free. Fitting and any other agreed project work are quoted separately.

Can I ask about fitting flooring I already have?

Yes. Send the exact flooring specification, room details and any installation instructions. FBS will review the fitting requirements and discuss suitability before agreeing the work.

Where do you work?

FBS is based in Coolock, Dublin. Share your town or Eircode so the team can confirm whether they can arrange a consultation or fitting for your location.

title: Flooring Consultation & Fitting Questions
description: Answers about free consultations, fitting enquiries, project preparation, locations and quotations from FBS.
content:
What services does FBS offer?

FBS offers free home consultations, measuring and advice, and professional fitting in collaboration with fitting specialists. Discuss your new-home, renovation, residential or commercial project with the team.

Is the home consultation free?

Yes. FBS’s home consultation is free. Fitting and any other agreed project work are quoted separately.

Can I ask about fitting flooring I already have?

Yes. Send the exact flooring specification, room details and any installation instructions. FBS will review the fitting requirements and discuss suitability before agreeing the work.

Where do you work?

FBS is based in Coolock, Dublin. Share your town or Eircode so the team can confirm whether they can arrange a consultation or fitting for your location.

How much does fitting cost?

The quotation depends on your rooms, floor area, existing surface and agreed fitting scope. Contact FBS with your project details; no fixed fitting rate is published on this website.

What should I prepare before getting in touch?

Room photographs, approximate measurements and a floor plan are useful. Share your timing and the flooring specification if you already have it. You can still get in touch if you have not measured yet.

Do you work on business premises?

FBS’s published information includes residential and commercial projects. Describe the space, how it is used and the access requirements so the fitting scope can be discussed.

Does an enquiry confirm an appointment?

No. FBS will need to agree the location, requirements and appointment or fitting date with you. Sending a message starts that conversation.

title: Privacy information
description: Privacy information for the FBS service website.
content:
Your enquiry

The enquiry tool runs in your browser. It prepares a message for your email app or WhatsApp. No enquiry is sent to FBS until you review it and send it using the app you choose. The details are passed to that service when you open the prepared message.

External services

Email, WhatsApp and Google Maps have their own privacy policies. Links to these services are opened only when you choose them. No map, advertising or social feed is embedded here.

Contact

For questions about information you send to FBS, contact info@fbsflooring.ie. For FBS’s wider privacy information, refer to its published privacy policy at fbsflooring.ie/privacy-policy/.

title: Cookies & site preferences
description: Cookies & site preferences for the FBS service website.
content:
This preview

This website does not include advertising analytics, marketing trackers or saved product lists. The room planner and enquiry builder run in your browser without saving your form details to local storage.

Linked services

If you open a linked service such as WhatsApp or Google Maps, that service applies its own cookies and privacy information. Hosting providers may use essential operational technology to deliver the website.
